column1: # sign hash baseline - worktree browser-buy-open-latency-20261012 @ dc3b1aef (v0.7.13), original assets theme-park-world ; re-pinned for COMPAT-005 (the slot percent scales each character width, tp.exe 0x5EAD01): composed halves and text pixel counts of the signs whose percent is not 100

# re-pinned for RIDES-010 (names bind by the executable's Info.Id table 0x7488D8, not by English name): displayName, line1, line2, left/right halves and text pixels of jungle/1431, hallow/2426, fantasy/4425 and space/3421 (Sign1 -> Large Sign), hallow/2120 (Thrill Grill -> The Firepit), space/3114 (Bounce On Iggy -> Cosmic Bounce) and space/3170 (Star Tours -> Cosmic Cruiser); the columns the test does not compare (fonts, fit iterations, timings) keep their v0.7.13 values
# hashes: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) over the composed CPU RGBA bytes ObjectSigns.Get returns (sign1/sign2 halves, 128x128x4) and over the raw .sgn member bytes

# re-pinned for the sign and gate round (October 15): the composed surface starts transparent (COMPAT-030 retired) and paint masks are offset by their record's offsets (COMPAT-003), and the halves are straight alpha with bled edge colours (EXT:sign-straight-alpha); every left/right half hash moved, no line, text pixel count or .sgn hash did

# re-pinned for COMPAT-003 (paint masks shaped as tp.exe 0x5EBF10 does: offset copy, erosion or dilation by the mask word, separable Gaussian by the parameter): 144 left/right half hashes moved; no line, text pixel count or .sgn hash did

# re-pinned for COMPAT-018 (the wavelet board's YCbCr conversion rounds each colour sum to the nearest whole number as tp.exe 0x5935A0 does, instead of truncating): 28 left/right half hashes of the 14 signs with a wavelet board moved; no line, text pixel count or .sgn hash did

# re-pinned for COMPAT-001 (the text DIB is reduced to the glyph mask by the original's 2x2 box, the four bytes summed and shifted right by 2, instead of two truncated halvings, tp.exe 0x5EAFC3, and the surface, glyph masks, paint shaping and relief extent run 256 rows high with only the top 128 packed, 0x5ECB40): every left/right half hash (75 signs) moved and the text pixel counts of 8 signs; no line or .sgn hash did

# re-pinned for COMPAT-003 (the relief is shaded from a shape, not the raw coverage: the effect's mask word erodes the binary ink with smoothstep levels and its parameter blurs it, tp.exe 0x5EB820 / 0x5EB270 / 0x5EB3E0, with the normals read without clamping and the colour summed in the original's order, 0x5EB8A0): every left/right half hash (75 signs) moved; no line, text pixel count or .sgn hash did

# re-pinned for COMPAT-003 (the blurs, the bevel levels and the relief arithmetic run on emulated x87 registers at the single precision of tp.exe's thread, instruction for instruction: kernel taps and sums rounded to 24 bits, the truncated sums, the light and half vectors, the normals, the dots, the pow and the colour sum, tp.exe 0x5EA8A0 / 0x5EB3E0 / 0x5EB270 / 0x5EB8A0; the CRT sets 53 bits at 0x6804D0 and DDSCL_FPUSETUP makes the shipped D3DIM.DLL CreateDevice set 24): 72 of 75 left/right half pairs moved; no line, text pixel count or .sgn hash did

# re-pinned for COMPAT-018 (the wavelet decoder runs tp.exe's arithmetic instruction for instruction at the thread's x87 precision: the header scale multiplies each dequantised coefficient instead of the row filter, the D4 coefficients are the 53 bit static initialisers 0x591600..0x591690 stored as float32, the row and column inverses 0x592C50 / 0x5933A0 / 0x592E60 sum in the original's operand order at 24 bits, and the colour conversion 0x5935A0 forms the chroma terms once per 2x2 block and adds the luma to Cb*1.772 + magic, Cr*1.402 + magic and (magic - Cb*0.344136) - Cr*0.714136 as separate float32 roundings): 28 left/right half hashes of the 14 signs with a wavelet board moved; no line, text pixel count or .sgn hash did
